metadata.description: ADAM — a self-evolving digital organism with memory, beliefs, skills, and governed self-mutation.

plugins.name: adam
plugins.description: Adds the ADAM MCP tools: inspect the organism's genome and identity, store and query durable memory, read and update beliefs, run registered skills, propose/accept/reject governed mutations to its own genome, and review evolution history and reflections. First run builds the release binary automatically (a Rust toolchain must be installed); see the repository README.
